body.message:
Hello Emirhan,

We have double checked with our management, and they have confirmed that the rent of AED 4,500 for 6 months is acceptable as a fixed price.

Kindly note that to confirm the 6-month booking, we require payment for the first and last month upfront, while the remaining months can be paid on a monthly basis. A security deposit of AED 3,000 is also applicable.

Please let us know if you are comfortable with these terms, and we will be happy to arrange a viewing for you.
